title-info.book-title: Tribulation of Myriad Races — Chapter 1496: Complications (1)

section.p: Three of the Invincibles attacking Great Qin King had died. Two divines and one devil. He was still surrounded by thirteen living Invincibles while Xia Longwu and the others were facing three. Five Invincibles had died in total.

With the appearance of Great Qin King, Lan Tian, and Su Yu, the top experts from three different generations had revealed themselves. One could say that Su Yu was the most extreme version of the top expert from his generation. In his generation, he was practically unrivalled.
Far away, Su Yu remained indifferent.
He looked around and coldly said, “Are people like you really qualified to be called Invincibles?”
He was provoking them.
He was too arrogant.

His entire body was shining brightly as he absorbed the heavenly reward. Such a reward might not be too useful for Invincibles. But for Su Yu, it was extremely useful. There was one benefit to absorbing heavenly reward. It was easier to absorb, but it might also result in unstable cultivation since the absorption speed was too fast. That was of no concern to Su Yu.

A death sovereign was still charging toward him from afar. Even further away, Xing Yue was cursing inwardly. Fortunately, she hadn’t started fighting. After all, she was still facing the Heaven Department head. If she was already fighting actively, she might end up dying due to Su Yu’s absorption of her death qi.
Su Yu the freak.
He might have killed an Invincible through a series of circumstances instead of relying on his strength alone, but it was undeniable that he had killed an Invincible.
He had done it with his own hands.
Great Qin King had killed one of the tri-life bodies while he had killed the remaining tri-life bodies.
“Su Yu!”

The Invincibles continued roaring. The divines and immortals had each lost two out of their five Invincibles. As for the devils, they had lost one out of their seven Invincibles. Twelve Invincibles remained among them.
As for the dragons, nethers, and celestial chasms, there were four Invincibles among them.

If Great Qin King was still uninjured, this might still be a slightly winnable fight for the humans. Unfortunately, Great Qin King was already greatly injured and exhausted. He could still kill more Invincibles, but it would probably be at the cost of his own life.
“Yes? Why are you calling your grandpa?” Su Yu said, “Garbage. You need to thank me for this. Without me, how can you fight in peace? I removed a lot of your baggage for you.”
At that, Lightning Divine King asked, “Did you kill Wushuang and the others?”
“Nope.”

Su Yu offered, “If the divines are willing to withdraw, I guarantee that I won’t trouble the divines anymore. This will also be applicable to the other humans. If they dare to break the promise, I will turn against them. They will no longer know a day of peace. This is my promise. What do you think? If you agree, I’ll release Zhan Wushuang and the others.”
“Dream on!”
Lightning Divine King said, “Su Yu, you are dreaming.”
“Stubborn fool.” Su Yu said, “Fine. Let’s see how many of you are prepared to die today.”
There were sixteen enemy Invincibles left. This did not include the death sovereigns and some other living Invincibles, such as those from the five elemental race.

Su Yu did not bother to give the Heaven Department head any look. He didn’t know what the department head was planning, but since the department head was keeping the death spirits occupied, Su Yu concluded that the department head was no friend of his as well.
“Su Yu, you’re dead!” Lightning Divine King roared, “Kill!”

He was trying to kill Great Qin King. With Great Qin King being so seriously injured, it would be stupid of them to waste more time on Su Yu instead of focusing on Great Qin King first. With Great Qin King dead, all the other humans here would die as well. As for Su Yu, the death sovereign would deal with him.
Before long, the death sovereign caught up with Su Yu.
At that moment, Su Yu roared, “He Tu, handle him for me!”
Outside the city, He Tu blanked out.
Yes, he knew Su Yu. But wasn’t Su Yu a tad bit too arrogant here? Why was Su Yu ordering him around? Just because Su Yu had defeated his remnant will before? What nonsense was that?

He Tu decided to ignore Su Yu. Just then, he received a voice transmission from Su Yu, “He Tu, don’t you want the ability to leave and enter the Death Realm freely? Were there 360 stars where you entered the mansion? Do you think you can still move through that place freely in the future? I don’t think so. But I know how to activate those stars. If we join hands, you might be able to leave Grand Dream City freely as well.”
He Tu ignored the offer. He was uninterested.

“He Tu, do you want to come back to life? To become a real, living being again? I can help you with that. You are familiar with death qi reversal, right? If you still have your past memories, you should understand that upon reaching a certain level of strength, I might be able to bring you back to life. Did you not consider this back then? Nowadays, I am the only person with 360 acupoints open in the Myriad Realms. I am the only person with the reversal technique. You might know it as well, but you’re already dead. Can you still do it?”
He Tu trembled.
Nobody knew this.
But he knew.
Yes.
He knew the reversal technique. That was one of his trump cards back then. That was why he could lead the death spirits in a war against all living beings.
He had opened 360 acupoints. That was why he could do so.
But back then, he was alone.
That was no longer the case.
Su Yu!
Resurrection?
Yes. He knew it was possible. Back then, he tried doing the same. However, it was too dangerous. He failed his attempts, but that did not mean that it wasn’t possible.
“He Tu, you know me best in the Myriad Realms. Nobody knows us. We are the same type of people. If I promise to resurrect you, nobody will believe me. But you will. Am I right?”
Su Yu ignored the death sovereign waiting nearby. He was focusing on He Tu. He was betting on He Tu’s desire to return to life.

As for Xing Yue, she could keep the Heaven Department head busy for now. This would help in confusing the celestial chasm race as well. Perhaps they were starting to suspect him. However, Xing Yue was the one who had signed the oath with them, not He Tu. Furthermore, Xing Yue couldn’t do much for now since he was absorbing Xing Yue’s death qi.
He Tu’s expression changed repeatedly.
Resurrection.
The look in his eyes turned complicated. Could Su Yu do it?

Perhaps. It was very dangerous. He knew because he had tried it himself. At the time, he had detonated several death spirits accidentally during the process. But he still believed that it was possible.

He was very familiar with the reversal technique. Thus, he found himself believing in Su Yu. Prior to this, he was unaware that Su Yu knew the reversal technique. But now, he finally understood. That was the source of Su Yu’s confidence.
Space rippled as the death sovereign near Su Yu started attacking. Su Yu was just about to take his life death fruit out when He Tu acted.
“Stop!” The mighty He Tu appeared before the death sovereign and said, “Fulai, he is mine.”
Yes. His.

Su Yu exhaled in relief. Hopefully, this would keep the celestial chasm race confused. This might be the way to mislead them into believing that He Tu might be the reason for all the actions Xing Yue had taken thus far.
He couldn’t let them believe that Xing Yue was the leader here. The exposure of his association with Xing Yue would make it far harder for him to deal with the celestial chasm race.

He Tu’s appearance was perfect to dissolve the suspicion they might be feeling. Like Su Yu, He Tu had climbed the mansion from the first level. Meanwhile, Xing Yue had left through the death tunnel. Nobody would expect that Xing Yue was someone who had traveled all the way from Grandstar City to look for Su Yu here.
Not far away, Xing Yue was shaking with anger.
Sure enough!
Sure enough!
That bastard had dumped her! He had gotten together with He Tu! Sure enough, he was abandoning her because she was weaker than He Tu! He had gotten together with He Tu!

For the most part, death spirits were extremely hard to negotiate with. That was because most treasures were useless for them. They loved nothing more than killing. But Su Yu had tempted He Tu with the possibility of resurrection.
Because they were the same.
They had both opened 360 acupoints. They knew the reversal technique. Nobody knew Su Yu better than He Tu. Nobody knew how feasible it was except He Tu, even if it would be a dangerous process.

He couldn’t allow Su Yu to die. Su Yu was the sole person capable of resurrecting death spirits in existence. There was no other individual with 360 acupoints open in existence. And even someone with 360 acupoints open might not necessarily be able to learn the reversal technique. Since He Tu was dead, he couldn’t even impart the technique to anyone anymore.
“He Tu?”
The excited death sovereign finally calmed down. He was not as strong as He Tu.
He asked in surprise and fury, “He Tu! Why are you stopping me? I’m here because of the heavenly laws!”
How could He Tu stop him when he was here because of the heavenly laws?

He Tu gave a simple reply, “Fuck off. I can’t do much to you now since you’re here because of the laws. But when you return to the Death Realm, I will attack your kingdom and send you to eternal slumber. You will only receive a small punishment for disobeying the heavenly laws. But you will cease to exist if you disobey me.”
Silence descended.

The death sovereign was furious, but he knew that he wasn’t He Tu’s match. He did not care about living Invincibles. At worst, he could run back to the Death Realm. But he didn’t dare to cross a death sovereign lightly. He Tu was very powerful even in the Death Realm. Furthermore, he was someone with numerous allies.
At the same time, numerous people blanked out.
He Tu.
